lines.speaker: dhawale
lines.text: Before you sit down, sir, the western parcel goes to me.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Move away from my chair.

lines.speaker: dhawale
lines.text: Of course. A presiding officer should never look instructed.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Sarika, call the matter.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: Sir, I need... I need one minute first.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Call it.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: There are forty-six people inside. More on the stairs.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Then forty-six people are waiting for you to begin.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: And your son is standing at the back.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: tejas
lines.text: Papa.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: You should be at college.

lines.speaker: tejas
lines.text: Our lecture was cancelled. Mummy said you had a major hearing.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: She sent you?

lines.speaker: tejas
lines.text: She said I should finally see what you do.

lines.speaker: dhawale
lines.text: A proud day. First-year law, isn't it? Stand where you can hear.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Do not address my son.

lines.speaker: dhawale
lines.text: As you please, sir.

lines.speaker: VOICE IN ROOM
lines.text: How long will it take? We have been here since morning.

lines.speaker: SECOND VOICE IN ROOM
lines.text: Let the court start. Some of us came from two districts away.

lines.speaker: tejas
lines.text: They call this a court?

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: They call it a forum. Sit quietly.

lines.speaker: tejas
lines.text: There is no seat.

lines.speaker: dhawale
lines.text: Someone give the young law student a chair.

lines.speaker: VOICE IN ROOM
lines.text: Take mine, beta. His father settled my shop dispute in six days.

lines.speaker: SECOND VOICE IN ROOM
lines.text: Mine too. The other party paid every rupee.

lines.speaker: tejas
lines.text: Papa... all these people came for you?

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Sarika. Call the matter.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: Matter number two zero eight. Consolidated redevelopment dispute. Thirty-one claimants against the acquiring partnership.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: Property stated at three crore sixty lakh rupees.

lines.speaker: VOICE IN ROOM
lines.text: Speak louder. We cannot hear at the back.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: Three crore sixty lakh rupees.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Appearances.

lines.speaker: dhawale
lines.text: I appear for the acquiring partnership, with written authority.

lines.speaker: CLAIMANT
lines.text: We appear for our families. We have signed the consent sheet.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Consent to this forum, or consent to the sale?

lines.speaker: CLAIMANT
lines.text: To a hearing here. Not to his price.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Good. Those are different things.

lines.speaker: dhawale
lines.text: The contracted price is fair and already accepted in principle.

lines.speaker: CLAIMANT
lines.text: Accepted before he removed twelve families from the compensation schedule.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Silence. One voice at a time.

lines.speaker: CLAIMANT
lines.text: Sir, my mother is seventy-three. Her room is on the survey map.

lines.speaker: dhawale
lines.text: Her occupation is not supported by an individual title.

lines.speaker: CLAIMANT
lines.text: The building stood before his company existed.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Show me the survey map.

lines.speaker: dhawale
lines.text: The relevant map is tab seven.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: This copy has twelve names marked in blue ink.

lines.speaker: CLAIMANT
lines.text: Those are the families he removed.

lines.speaker: dhawale
lines.text: Those are disputed occupants.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Who made the blue marks?

lines.speaker: dhawale
lines.text: An internal survey team.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Name the surveyor.

lines.speaker: dhawale
lines.text: That level of detail will delay everyone in this room.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Name the surveyor.

lines.speaker: dhawale
lines.text: I will obtain it.

lines.speaker: CLAIMANT
lines.text: He does not have one, sir. He made those marks himself.

lines.speaker: dhawale
lines.text: That is a reckless allegation.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: And it remains an allegation until evidence proves it.

lines.speaker: tejas
lines.text: That was good, Papa.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: No comments from the gallery.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: Sir, should I record the surveyor's name as pending?

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Record it. The acquiring partnership will produce the original survey register.

lines.speaker: dhawale
lines.text: There is no need for an adjournment.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: I did not say there would be one.

lines.speaker: dhawale
lines.text: Then perhaps we can finish exactly as discussed.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Nothing was discussed.

lines.speaker: dhawale
lines.text: Quite right. Nothing suitable for the record.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Place your valuation on record.

lines.speaker: dhawale
lines.text: Two crore ten lakh for the complete parcel.

lines.speaker: CLAIMANT
lines.text: The municipal valuation is three crore sixty lakh.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Why is your offer one crore fifty lakh lower?

lines.speaker: dhawale
lines.text: Vacating costs. Litigation risk. Defective occupation papers.

lines.speaker: CLAIMANT
lines.text: He created the defects. Then he priced them.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Enough. I will examine each listed occupant.

lines.speaker: dhawale
lines.text: Forty-six people are waiting, sir.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: They came for a hearing, not a stamp.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: Please, no clapping. This is... please maintain order.

lines.speaker: VOICE IN ROOM
lines.text: Let him speak. At least somebody is asking the builder questions.

lines.speaker: SECOND VOICE IN ROOM
lines.text: We spent four years outside the real court.

lines.speaker: tejas
lines.text: Papa, they respect you.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Sit down.

lines.speaker: dhawale
lines.text: Yes. They respect you very much.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Call the first disputed occupant.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: Occupant one, unit three. Please come forward.

lines.speaker: OLDER CLAIMANT
lines.text: Sir, I have lived there for thirty-eight years.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Do you have electricity bills?

lines.speaker: OLDER CLAIMANT
lines.text: Every bill since nineteen ninety-eight. Earlier ones were in my husband's name.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Sarika, mark the bills collectively.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: Sir, my signature will go on the exhibit sheet.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: That is your work.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: Is it? After what you told me?

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: We will not discuss staff matters during a hearing.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: Then you mark it.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Excuse me?

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: I will write the number. I will not certify anything today.

lines.speaker: VOICE IN ROOM
lines.text: What is happening? Is the clerk refusing the judge?

lines.speaker: dhawale
lines.text: An unfortunate display, in front of his own son.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Mark the document without certification. Continue.

lines.speaker: tejas
lines.text: Why is she afraid to sign?

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Not now.

lines.speaker: dhawale
lines.text: The answer may take longer than this hearing.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: You will remain silent unless addressed.

lines.speaker: dhawale
lines.text: Certainly, sir. Shall I place my settlement draft before you?

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: There will be no settlement until all twelve claims are examined.

lines.speaker: dhawale
lines.text: That envelope is not a settlement.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Take it back.

lines.speaker: dhawale
lines.text: You should read page four.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: I said, take it back.

lines.speaker: dhawale
lines.text: Page four contains the operative portion of today's award.

lines.speaker: CLAIMANT
lines.text: Today's award? He brought it already written?

lines.speaker: SECOND VOICE IN ROOM
lines.text: Sir, what does he mean?

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: He means nothing. The hearing will continue.

lines.speaker: dhawale
lines.text: The western parcel transfers to me at two crore ten lakh.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: No ruling has been made.

lines.speaker: dhawale
lines.text: The twelve blue names receive nothing. Paragraph seven records their withdrawal.

lines.speaker: OLDER CLAIMANT
lines.text: I never withdrew. Sir, tell him I never withdrew.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Nobody has withdrawn.

lines.speaker: dhawale
lines.text: Then you may prefer the other envelope.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: What is in it?

lines.speaker: dhawale
lines.text: Copies of twelve earlier awards. Each one says exactly what your clerk was told to type.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: Sir... is that what those sealed envelopes were?

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Do not touch either envelope.

lines.speaker: dhawale
lines.text: Your room is full today. Your son is watching. Choose the paper that preserves both.

lines.speaker: tejas
lines.text: Papa, why does he have your old orders?

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: The hearing is adjourned.

lines.speaker: VOICE IN ROOM
lines.text: Adjourned to when? We paid the filing fee.

lines.speaker: OLDER CLAIMANT
lines.text: Sir, do not send us away with him.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Clear the room. Sarika, clear the room now.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: Everyone outside, please. Take your documents. Do not leave signatures behind.

lines.speaker: dhawale
lines.text: I will wait downstairs. A man thinks more clearly after applause ends.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Get out.

lines.speaker: dhawale
lines.text: With pleasure, sir.

lines.speaker: tejas
lines.text: Papa, look at me.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Go home. I will explain there.

lines.speaker: tejas
lines.text: No. I heard what he said.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: He is trying to control a ruling.

lines.speaker: tejas
lines.text: And the clerk would not sign. Those people called you judge.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: I never asked you to come here.

lines.speaker: tejas
lines.text: I came because I wanted to tell my class what my father does.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: This is private dispute resolution. Parties consent. Awards are enforced by agreement.

lines.speaker: tejas
lines.text: We studied arbitration last month. I know the words.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Then you know an arbitrator can conduct proceedings outside a courthouse.

lines.speaker: tejas
lines.text: Yes. After someone lawfully appoints him.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Tejas—

lines.speaker: tejas
lines.text: Which court appointed you?

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Open every register. If his tribunal existed for one day, I want that day.

lines.speaker: RECORDS CLERK
lines.text: We checked the current index twice, sir.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Then check the retired index once, properly.

lines.speaker: RECORDS CLERK
lines.text: The name on his letter is only presiding officer. No appointment number.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: That omission is why we are here.

lines.speaker: RECORDS CLERK
lines.text: He enclosed consent memoranda from private parties.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Consent is not an order of this court.

lines.speaker: RECORDS CLERK
lines.text: He says the forum exercises consensual jurisdiction.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: He was asked for one document. He sent twenty-seven different documents instead.

lines.speaker: RECORDS CLERK
lines.text: Perhaps the appointment came from another district.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: His letter says competent court. It does not name one.

lines.speaker: RECORDS CLERK
lines.text: I will bring the old arbitration register.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The requested eleven days ended. The register did not change its answer.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Read from November two thousand twenty-two.

lines.speaker: RECORDS CLERK
lines.text: Court-appointed arbitrator, one entry. Retired engineer. Commercial drainage dispute.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Next.

lines.speaker: RECORDS CLERK
lines.text: No further appointment that month.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: December.

lines.speaker: RECORDS CLERK
lines.text: Two appointments. Neither matches the forum, officer or address.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Continue through this month.

lines.speaker: RECORDS CLERK
lines.text: Sir, that is fourteen months of entries.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Exactly.

lines.speaker: RECORDS CLERK
lines.text: Should I call the civil filing section?

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Call every section that can issue or preserve an appointment.

lines.speaker: RECORDS CLERK
lines.text: Civil filing, records. Registrar's verification. Search all orders appointing a private arbitrator at the tyre-shop address.

lines.speaker: VOICE ON PHONE
lines.text: Repeat the address.

lines.speaker: RECORDS CLERK
lines.text: Second floor, above the tyre shop. Nameplate says arbitration and dispute resolution forum.

lines.speaker: VOICE ON PHONE
lines.text: We have no court facility at that address.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Ask for appointments, not facilities.

lines.speaker: RECORDS CLERK
lines.text: Any appointment naming that address or that forum?

lines.speaker: VOICE ON PHONE
lines.text: Nothing in civil filing.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Execution section next.

lines.speaker: RECORDS CLERK
lines.text: Execution section, please.

lines.speaker: VOICE ON PHONE
lines.text: Execution.

lines.speaker: RECORDS CLERK
lines.text: Do you hold any recognised award from that forum?

lines.speaker: VOICE ON PHONE
lines.text: One came attached to another filing. It was sent to the registrar.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: That is case one seven six. Any other case number?

lines.speaker: VOICE ON PHONE
lines.text: No recognised sequence. Their numbers do not correspond with ours.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Thank you. Close the call.

lines.speaker: RECORDS CLERK
lines.text: Sir, should we send a second notice?

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: No. He answered the first notice.

lines.speaker: RECORDS CLERK
lines.text: Without the order you requested.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: That is also an answer.

lines.speaker: RECORDS CLERK
lines.text: Then what do I write in the verification note?

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Write only what the record proves.

lines.speaker: RECORDS CLERK
lines.text: No appointment located?

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: More precise.

lines.speaker: RECORDS CLERK
lines.text: No order appointing the named presiding officer was found.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Good. Next line.

lines.speaker: RECORDS CLERK
lines.text: No tribunal under the stated name was constituted by this district court.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Next.

lines.speaker: RECORDS CLERK
lines.text: No official case-number sequence corresponds with the numbers used on the submitted awards.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Add that the seal does not match any approved court seal.

lines.speaker: RECORDS CLERK
lines.text: The seal says dispute resolution forum. It does not actually say district court.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: The page heading says presiding officer. The language says judgment. The recipients were expected to obey.

lines.speaker: RECORDS CLERK
lines.text: Are we saying he impersonated a judge?

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: We are saying what the documents say. The police will identify the offence.

lines.speaker: RECORDS CLERK
lines.text: There are thirty-four awards in the bundle.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: And how much property changed hands?

lines.speaker: RECORDS CLERK
lines.text: I can calculate from the stated values.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Do not estimate. List each award and each stated consequence.

lines.speaker: RECORDS CLERK
lines.text: Possession, payment, conveyance, access, surrender of keys...

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: People surrendered things because that paper looked official.

lines.speaker: RECORDS CLERK
lines.text: Some may say they consented.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Then their statements will say so. The record will not guess for them.

lines.speaker: RECORDS CLERK
lines.text: And the registry clerk? Her signature appears on every certified copy.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Identify her. Do not call her an accused without evidence of knowledge.

lines.speaker: RECORDS CLERK
lines.text: She certified proceedings that never belonged to a court.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: She may have believed her employer. That is a fact to investigate, not decorate.

lines.speaker: RECORDS CLERK
lines.text: Understood.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Print the verification note. I will sign the complaint.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: By afternoon, the question in the registrar's drawer had become a police file.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: Who discovered the first award?

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: It arrived as an attachment to an unrelated filing.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: You personally checked the appointment registers?

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Current, retired and section indexes. No appointment exists in our records.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: No arbitrator?

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: No appointed arbitrator under that name or designation.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: No tribunal?

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: No tribunal constituted by the district court.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: No case numbers?

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: His sequence is his own. It has no registry source.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: And yet people transferred land, money and possession.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: The attached documents indicate that. Their statements must confirm it.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: You speak like every word has to survive cross-examination.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Every word in a public record should.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: Good. I dislike repairing enthusiastic complaints.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: This one requires no enthusiasm.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: Read paragraph six before you sign.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: The respondent was struck from professional practice fifteen years earlier.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: Can you prove that?

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: The bar record is attached.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: Then sign.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: There.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: I will take two constables. No media, no procession.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: The room may be full.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: Then we will wait until it is not. Courtesy costs nothing.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: They reached the tyre-shop stairwell after the evening shutters began to fall.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: Sir, police are coming up.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Close the files. Put the seal in the drawer.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: No. I am not hiding anything else.

lines.speaker: tejas
lines.text: Papa, who are they?

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: You were told to go home.

lines.speaker: tejas
lines.text: You never answered me.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: Nobody move down the stairs, please. There is sufficient room for dignity.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Do you have a warrant?

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: I have a registered complaint and authority to secure the records.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: This is an arbitration office. Client files are confidential.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: It is not an office constituted by the court.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: You.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: You received my letter. You chose not to produce an appointment order.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Parties appointed me by consent.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Your heading represented a presiding authority that did not exist.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: That is your interpretation.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: You may provide yours at the station.

lines.speaker: tejas
lines.text: Station? Are you arresting my father?

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: He will accompany us. Do not block the stairway.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: Inspector, my signatures are on the copies. Am I... am I going too?

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: You are not under arrest.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: But can they charge me later?

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: The complaint names you as an employee and witness. Give us the files truthfully, and you remain a witness.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: All of them?

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: Every register, seal, signed blank sheet and certified copy.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: There are three cartons behind the dais.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Sarika, say nothing until you have counsel.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: You told me I was registry staff. You told me my signature made the copy proper.

lines.speaker: tejas
lines.text: Papa... were you ever appointed?

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Not here.

lines.speaker: tejas
lines.text: There is nowhere else left.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: Sir, turn toward me. I will read the allegation before we move.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Do it quietly.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: The charge is cheating by falsely representing judicial authority, and dishonestly inducing the delivery of money, property and possession through documents presented as lawful awards.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: Name every award, call it worthless, and the prosecution will record your cooperation.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: You want me to condemn all of them before trial.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: I want a complete list and a truthful description of your authority.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: There was no court appointment. That part is already established by the record.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Then why do you need me?

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: Because thirty-four papers changed thirty-four lives, and your handwriting joins them.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Some disputes were genuine.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: A genuine dispute does not create a genuine tribunal.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Parties came voluntarily.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: Some did. Some were told a presiding officer had summoned them.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: I never used the district court's name.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: You used its language, procedure and appearance.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Language belongs to no court.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Authority does.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: This can be a short interview or a long case. Your choice remains respectable either way.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: What exactly are you offering?

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: Full disclosure. Identification of every affected person. Admission that the awards have no judicial force.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: And then?

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: Your cooperation goes into the remand report and the prosecution brief.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Lighter charges?

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: A narrower allegation, if the evidence permits. Better bail grounds. No promise beyond that.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: And if I refuse?

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: The file becomes larger. Large files are inconvenient companions.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: The people who obeyed you must be told what those papers were.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: You mean what they were not.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Both.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: Start with matter one. Speak clearly for the recorder.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Matter one concerned a housing lockout and six thousand rupees withheld.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: Name of the applicant?

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: It is on the file.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: You are being offered cooperation credit. Cooperate.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Irfan.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: What authority did you have to issue that direction?

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: None granted by a court.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: Did the landlord pay because of it?

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: He restored the key and paid six thousand rupees.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: Then state whether the direction had judicial force.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: It did not have judicial force.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Matter two.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: A supplier recovered forty-two thousand rupees from a contractor.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: Authority?

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: No court appointment.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: Force of award?

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: No judicial force.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Matter three.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Possession of a rented storeroom.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: Matter four.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Payment of seventeen thousand five hundred rupees.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: Matter five.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Release of tools held against an unpaid loan.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Were any of those outcomes dictated through sealed envelopes?

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Not the first five.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: Which was the first?

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Matter nine.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: Who gave you the envelope?

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: A registry clerk.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: The complaint will require his identity.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: It is in my statement.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: And what did you receive?

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Access to the pending list.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: So you could select disputes that had not reached a real court.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: So I could avoid conflicting proceedings.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: A careful description of the same concealment.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: You asked for truth, not humiliation.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: The truth is not responsible for your humiliation.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: Gentlemen. Matter nine.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: A commercial tenancy. The envelope required possession for the claimant.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: Did you rule accordingly?

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: Matter ten.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: A machinery payment. The envelope fixed the amount at eighty-six thousand rupees.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: And you copied it?

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: I wrote reasons around it.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Did the reasons change the required outcome?

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: Matter eleven.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: A boundary dispute. Three feet of access land.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: Matter twelve.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Withdrawal of a complaint after payment.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: Continue.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: He named payments, shops, rooms and parcels. Each answer shortened the mercy he was asking from those papers.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Matter twenty-two. Delivery of a vehicle after payment of one lakh twelve thousand.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: No judicial force?

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: No judicial force.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: Matter twenty-three.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: A family loan. Monthly repayment fixed at eight thousand.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: No judicial force?

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: No judicial force.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Matter twenty-four.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Land access between a sister and brother.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: Full description.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: The sister held an equal recorded share. Her brother controlled both keys.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: For how long?

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Eleven years.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: What did your award direct?

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Access and possession according to her recorded share. No lease of the western half.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Did the brother comply?

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: He gave her both keys.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: Then complete the statement. The award had no judicial force.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Next matter.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: No. Finish matter twenty-four.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: The recorded share was hers.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: That may be true. Your authority was not.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Her brother obeyed.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Because he believed a court had spoken.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: For eleven years, nobody else spoke for her.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: This interview is not deciding the land dispute.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: That room did.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: That room was not a court.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: It listened when the court had not.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: She never filed in the district court.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: She could not wait another eleven years to be heard.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: Say the required sentence, and we continue.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: If I say it, what happens to her keys?

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: The parties will be notified that the award has no legal authority.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Her brother will take them back.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: He may seek lawful determination.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: He held everything for eleven years without one.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: You are not protecting her title by refusing.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: I am protecting the one day she was believed.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: That sentence will not help your bail application.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Then leave it out.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: The list must be complete.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: It is complete through matter twenty-three.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: And matter twenty-four?

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: I will not call that judgment worthless.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: It was not a judgment.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: She stood before me with eleven years of crop accounts. He had both keys.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: None of that appointed you.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: Then state it.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: Understand the cost. I record partial cooperation, refusal to identify all awards as unauthorised, and continuing assertion of judicial power.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Record it.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: The narrower allegation may no longer be available.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Record that too.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Why preserve one lie after admitting thirty-three?

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Because that one made a man return keys he had no right to keep.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: You do not get to decide which false authority becomes noble.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: No. I decided when it cost me nothing. I am deciding this one when it costs me everything.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: Interview suspended. Time, six forty-two.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The incomplete list entered the police file. Matter twenty-four did not.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: Should the sister be contacted tonight?

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Not without a formal notice and a complete verified copy.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: The brother may hear of the arrest first.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Then we move carefully.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Do not call her.

lines.speaker: khot
lines.text: That decision is no longer yours.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Please... let her keep one night.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Across town, Manjula locked the western gate with one key and the house with the other.
lines.sfx_cue: two keys jingling, gate lock closing

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: She still held both keys. No one told her.

reached the largest public display of his false authority

state_changes.fact: ceased certifying documents for Morris
lost his clerk's public compliance

state_changes.fact: openly asserted control over Morris's next ruling
was publicly exposed as vulnerable to dictated outcomes
heard evidence that Morris's rulings were controlled

beat_sheet.what_happened: After the room cleared, Tejas asked Morris which court had appointed him.

state_changes.fact: directly questioned the source of Morris's authority
could no longer conceal the appointment question from his son

state_changes.fact: established from court records that Morris had no recorded appointment or tribunal
his claimed authority failed formal verification

state_changes.fact: was treated as a cooperating witness rather than arrested
gained access to three cartons of forum records

beat_sheet.what_happened: Khot read aloud the charge that Morris cheated people by falsely representing judicial authority and inducing transfers through purported awards.

state_changes.fact: was taken into police custody on a cheating allegation based on false judicial authority
learned publicly that no court appointment supported his father's forum

state_changes.fact: was offered possible leniency in exchange for disavowing all awards
began receiving Morris's statement identifying affected matters

beat_sheet.what_happened: Morris identified the earlier matters, admitted he lacked court appointment and stated that the first twenty-three awards had no judicial force.

state_changes.fact: formally disavowed his authority for the first twenty-three matters
gained Morris's partial admission and award list

beat_sheet.what_happened: Morris refused to call Manjula's award worthless despite being told that the refusal could cost him leniency.

state_changes.fact: sacrificed possible leniency rather than disavow Manjula's judgment
recorded only partial cooperation through matter twenty-three
her award was omitted from Morris's disavowal list

beat_sheet.what_happened: Manjula remained in possession of both keys and was not told about Morris's arrest or the challenge to his authority.

state_changes.fact: still held both keys without knowing that Morris's authority had been exposed
